labels: []

## Context

Which workflow did you try (library API, CLI, or both)? Which Node.js and TypeScript versions did you use?

## Reproduction (synthetic JSON only)

Link to an existing fictional fixture or share the smallest **fully synthetic** example. Never paste customer data, passwords, tokens, private URLs or production payloads.

## What helped?

Which change kind or JSON Pointer helped diagnose a problem? What was the result?

## Noise or missing behavior

Which findings were misleading? Are arrays positional or keyed by stable object IDs?

Are volatile fields excluded using explicit ignore paths? Which useful changes might that hide?

## Alternative tools and importance

Which existing JSON-diff/schema tools did you try? What unmet need justifies a new feature?

Would you use the library, CLI, CI integration or another format?

## Acceptance idea

What observable behavior or test would make the feature valuable?

> Feedback does not commit the project to implement or release a feature.
